name: Turbulence Risk-Scaling Overlay
description: Detects financial turbulence via Mahalanobis distance on a 5-asset-class return vector (VUSA, IMEU, VUTY, SGLN, COMM) and scales underlying risk weights toward safe asset (VUTY) when turbulence exceeds trailing percentile threshold. Implements Kritzman & Li (2010) — turbulence spikes when returns are unusually large OR correlations break structure. Risk-asset returns substantially lower during turbulent periods, and turbulence is persistent/forecastable, so de-risking after onset cuts max drawdown 20-40% with flat-to-slightly-lower raw return.
